class Solution:
    def removeNthFromEnd(self, head: ListNode, n: int) -> ListNode:
        dummy = ListNode(0, head)
        left = dummy
        right = head

        while n > 0:
            right = right.next
            n -= 1

        while right:
            left = left.next
            right = right.next

        # delete
        left.next = left.next.next
        return dummy.next

description: 删除链表倒数第 n 个节点，返回新头部。n 合法，链表用数组编码。
explanation: 哑节点后放两个指针，前指针先走 n+1 步，再同步推进，让后指针停在待删节点前。
memory: 先拉开固定间距，再一起走；哑节点处理删除头节点。
